20:12 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NBA Basketball
The Knicks host the Cavaliers in NBA regular-season play at Madison Square Garden. The New York Knicks have won all five of their most recent meetings with Cleveland, including a 109-97 victory at Rocket Arena in their most recent match.

22:35 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Houston Rockets host the Golden State Warriors in NBA regular-season play. The Houston Rockets have a three game lead out of the last five games against the Golden State Warriors. The most recent 115-107 win was in favor of Houston.
